result.edit: The failure occurs when processing a group starting with 000000. The state machine incorrectly transitions from sf4 to s1 when data is 0, causing incorrect classification of the next group's first bit. The change makes sf4 always transition to sf5, which maintains proper group boundary detection. This should fix the mismatch observed at cycle 12 where the output was 00 but should have been 01 for the first bit of a new group.
